summary: Iteration 24 tested lots per product, Cavidad and Tópico/Putrefacto logbook categories, purchases and mixes by lot, the Iniciar/Terminar embalming timer, date/time pickers, suppliers with WhatsApp, and the PDF Lote column. Backend: the new pytest file passes 14/14, the iter19-23 regression suites pass 47/47, and an edge probe found 4 minor issues. UI at 375x667: every requested flow works end to end. (1) The timer starts and stops, shows '0 h 00 min' and writes inicio_emb/termino_emb to the Hoja. (2) In the Cavidad tab, 8 oz deducts 0.5 bottle from lot CAV-1 and the entry shows 'Lote CAV-1'. (3) In the Tópico tab, Gel 50 g deducts 0.5 from TOP-1; Putrefacto (oz/mL) saves with a typed lot; saving without a lot is blocked. (4) In /case/new, the calendar (prev/next/day) and clock (h/m/ok) work; duration shows '2 h 15 min'; the values saved are correct in Mexico time (09:30 -> 15:30Z). The Hoja pickers work on /case/new and /case/sheet. (5) In Inventario, the 6 kind chips work, lot is required when stock > 0, per-lot +/- works, adding lot ART-C works, a purchase into ART-C adds stock to that lot (4 -> 6), the buy-sup chip fills the supplier, and the shopping list sends to wa.me/<phone>. (6) Suppliers: phone validation, add, sup-wa opens wa.me, and delete with confirm all work. (7) Mix confirm with chip ART-B deducts from ART-B only, the logbook entry shows 'Lote ART-B', and undo returns the stock to ART-B. (8) The wizard only shows arterial fluids, and the co-injector prefill leaves out cavidad, tópico and putrefacto entries. (9) The PDF has a Lote column with CJ-1, CAV-1, TOP-1 and GX-7 and the Cavidad, Topico and Putrefacto categories. Bugs found are 2 layout problems on web and a few minor logic gaps (see issues). No deprecated packages detected.

minor.issue: If the user picks an inventory product (fluid_id) but types a lot number that doesn't exist (lot_id null), _adjust_lot creates a new lot with 0 stock and deducts nothing. The entry is saved with deducted -0.0 and the user gets no warning. Repro: fluid with lot E-1 (2 bottles), log 100 mL with lot 'TYPO-9' -> lots become [E-1 2.0, TYPO-9 0.0].

If the original lot was deleted, the refund goes to a different lot (the first one with stock), which inflates that lot. Repro: deduct 0.5 from E-2, delete lot E-2, delete the entry -> E-1 goes from 2.0 to 2.5.

If the product unit doesn't match the entry unit (for example a tópico created via API with unit ml and logged in g, or a coinyector/otro in ml logged as Polvo g), _to_unit returns None and nothing is deducted. The user is not told.
The backend accepts an empty lot (200), even though the spec says the lot is required. Only the UI checks this.
An unknown lot_id returns 200 instead of 404.

ui_bugs.issue: On the Cálculos and Reporte tabs (long content), the horizontal tab ScrollView shrinks and the content card covers the bottom of the tab labels (tab box y 151-191, card starts at ~180), so 'Cálculos' and 'Notas' are cut off. Short tabs (Tópico) look fine. Cause: RN-web ScrollView defaults to flexShrink:1. Fix: style={{ flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0 }}.

ui_bugs.component: Inventory new-lot row (app/library/inventory.tsx:260) and shopping order inputs (:411)
ui_bugs.issue: The inv-newlot-stock-{id} input renders 26px wide instead of 90 (measured), and the inv-order-{id} inputs are also squeezed to about 26px, so typed numbers can't be read. Cause: { flex: 0, width: 90 } on web becomes flex-basis 0% with shrink. Fix: use { flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0, width: 90 } and add minWidth: 0 on the flex:1 input. This is the same root cause as the iter23 row-overflow note.

issues: If Término is earlier than Inicio, the case-duration text just disappears with no warning; there is also no check that the date of death is before the embalming date.
'Reiniciar' clears the recorded end and termino_emb right away, with no confirmation; one accidental tap loses the time.
Tópico products (g) still say 'botellas' in the stock label and in the WhatsApp order text.
The WhatsApp order line always prints 'Index X%, N mL', even for non-arterial or gram products (cavidad prints 'Index 0%').
Purchase history rows don't show the lot.
The purchase lot is optional and defaults to 'Sin lote'.
Generic ficha chips (SilentForm, DryForm, Anticlot…) appear in the Cavidad and Tópico categories as well.
The 3 time pickers in one row (Ingreso a sala / Inicio emb. / Término emb.) are about 110px each at 375px width, so values are tight.

action_items: Fix the case detail tab bar overlap: app/case/[id].tsx:452 ScrollView style -> { flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0 }.
Fix the squeezed inputs in Inventario: inv-newlot-stock and inv-order inputs -> { flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0, width: 90/80 }; add minWidth: 0 on the sibling flex:1 input.
ProductLogModal/backend: when fluid_id is set and the typed lot doesn't match an existing lot, either warn the user or don't create a 0-stock phantom lot; also clamp -0.0 to 0.
Logbook delete refund: if the lot_id no longer exists, recreate the lot by name (entry.lot) instead of refunding into another lot.
Warn or block when the entry unit can't be converted to the product unit (g vs ml), so no deduction is silently skipped.

Optional: make the lot required on the backend for logbook entries, return 404 for an unknown lot on DELETE, add a confirm on 'Reiniciar' in the timer, and use non-arterial and gram wording in the order text and stock label.
critical_code_review_comments: _adjust_lot does read-modify-write on the whole lots array (find, then $set lots). Two concurrent deductions on the same product can lose an update. Consider atomic $inc with arrayFilters on lots.$[l].stock and recomputing stock_bottles.
server.py is 2750 lines and case/[id].tsx is 1071 lines (over 700); split them into routers and components.
In mix-confirm, an invalid lot_id silently falls back to the first lot with stock.
Expo logs advise patch updates for expo (54.0.37), expo-constants and expo-file-system (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ fluids, cases, suppliers and purchases were created and then deleted by id; none remain. No seed or user data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. ui_setup_iter24.py creates an arterial fluid with lots ART-A(5) and ART-B(2), a cavidad (CAV-1), a tópico in g (TOP-1), a supplier and a case with an injection calc; it prints a JSON you can pass to 'cleanup'. MixSheet (mix-lot-*, mix-confirm, mix-undo) is in the Reporte tab, not Cálculos. The wizard step 2 needs at least one condición in the case sheet (for example ictericia). In /case/new, CaseSheetForm is compact, so s-fecha_ingreso, s-inicio_emb and s-termino_emb only appear on /case/sheet?caseId=. To capture WhatsApp URLs, override window.open before tapping. Skip Welcome with 'Saltar'.
rca_of_issue: Both layout bugs come from react-native-web flex defaults: ScrollView has flexShrink:1, and { flex: 0, width } becomes flex: 0 1 0%, so fixed widths are ignored when the content is tall or wide.
